description: This PHP file defines a model class 'SubunitTreeModel' that converts an array of 'Subunit' entities into a hierarchical tree structure suitable for serialization, mainly used in API responses. It includes documentation for API schema and manipulates nested subunit data based on hierarchical levels.

classes.name: SubunitTreeModel
classes.description: A model class that takes an array of Subunit entities and creates a nested hierarchical tree structure for API serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an array of Subunit objects to initialize the model.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the internal subunit array into a nested tree structure.

methods.name: toTree
methods.description: Recursive private method that builds a nested hierarchical tree from a flat collection based on subunit levels.
